# Prism Launcher

An open-source Minecraft launcher with the ability to manage multiple
instances, accounts and mods. Focused on user freedom and free
redistributability.

[Download](https://prismlauncher.org/download/linux)

![Prism Launcher screenshot showing off various different modpacks and instances](https://prismlauncher.org/_astro/linux_light.jDSJ-320_Z2wzXS8.png)![Prism Launcher screenshot showing off various different modpacks and instances](https://prismlauncher.org/_astro/linux_dark.h_D7aY-K_2o8X8m.png)

## Features

### Modpack Management

Prism Launcher makes it easier to install and launch modpacks, while
keeping them clean. You no longer need to manually install and update
modpacks as Prism Launcher can do this for you.

![Prism Launcher screenshot showing the modpack installation user-interface](https://prismlauncher.org/_astro/pack-install_light.BmIXRhrQ_Z24gEaX.png)![Prism Launcher screenshot showing the modpack installation user-interface](https://prismlauncher.org/_astro/pack-install_dark.DUO5iW2q_Z7iboK.png)![Prism Launcher screenshot showing the modpack updating user-interface](https://prismlauncher.org/_astro/pack-update_light.DQ2IXg8Z_ZqcwLC.png)![Prism Launcher screenshot showing the modpack updating user-interface](https://prismlauncher.org/_astro/pack-update_dark.BYX7DikN_Zrgust.png)

### Mod Management

Sick of constantly finding and re-adding that one mod you need? Prism
Launcher interfaces directly with Modrinth and CurseForge, allowing you to
update or install individual mods easily.

![Prism Launcher screenshot showing the mod installation user-interface](https://prismlauncher.org/_astro/mod-install_light.CGJuBk7W_lGTQh.png)![Prism Launcher screenshot showing the mod installation user-interface](https://prismlauncher.org/_astro/mod-install_dark.CT2tHrB6_Z22vq05.png)![Prism Launcher screenshot showing the mod updating user-interface](https://prismlauncher.org/_astro/mod-update_light.Clfo4Pji_ZFdOoA.png)![Prism Launcher screenshot showing the mod updating user-interface](https://prismlauncher.org/_astro/mod-update_dark.C7zA30XZ_Z1gzikv.png)

### Instance Management

Prism Launcher allows you to create and manage multiple instances of
Minecraft, each with its own settings, mods, and configurations. This
means you can easily switch between different setups without any issues.

![Prism Launcher screenshot showing the instance management user-interface](https://prismlauncher.org/_astro/instance-settings_light.C1emvG9A_ZcI0Ja.png)![Prism Launcher screenshot showing the instance management user-interface](https://prismlauncher.org/_astro/instance-settings_dark.VwPQ_hgz_Zg59QO.png)

### Lightweight and Customizable

You don't need an embedded web browser as a game launcher. Prism Launcher
is built with the Qt toolkit, requiring very few system resources to run.
It also lets you customize the menu and supports custom themes.

![Prism Launcher screenshot showing a themed user-interface](https://prismlauncher.org/_astro/themes_dark.D786xeAp_7IL84.png)

## I want that!

You can install Prism Launcher on Windows, MacOS, and Linux. See the [Download page](https://prismlauncher.org/download/linux) for more information. You can also
find community packages there.

## Get Involved

[Mastodon](https://floss.social/@PrismLauncher)[Bluesky](https://bsky.app/profile/prismlauncher.org)[Discord](https://discord.gg/ArX2nafFz2)[Matrix](https://matrix.to/#/#prismlauncher:matrix.org)[Reddit](https://www.reddit.com/r/PrismLauncher)[GitHub](https://github.com/PrismLauncher/PrismLauncher)[Email](mailto:contact@prismlauncher.org)

Prism Launcher is an open-source project and we welcome contributions from
the community. You can find the source code on [GitHub](https://github.com/PrismLauncher/PrismLauncher). Join our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/ArX2nafFz2) to chat
with other people. We also have a [Matrix space](https://matrix.to/#/#prismlauncher:matrix.org) for those who don't use Discord.

## Sponsors

We thank all the wonderful backers over at Open Collective! Support Prism
Launcher and it's development by [becoming a backer](https://opencollective.com/prismlauncher).

[![Prism Launcher Open Collective backers](https://opencollective.com/prismlauncher/backers.svg?width=840&limit=1000)](https://opencollective.com/prismlauncher#backers)

We also thank many wonderful companies who help us keep the lights on.

![JetBrains](https://resources.jetbrains.com/storage/products/company/brand/logos/jetbrains.svg)![Weblate](https://hosted.weblate.org/widgets/prismlauncher/-/open-graph.png)![MacStadium](https://uploads-ssl.webflow.com/5ac3c046c82724970fc60918/5c019d917bba312af7553b49_MacStadium-developerlogo.png)![Tutanota](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/1/10/Tuta_logo.svg)

## Other Information

Prism Launcher is [open-source](https://github.com/PrismLauncher/PrismLauncher) and licensed under GPL-3.

Prism Launcher's logo and related assets are licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0.

This website is powered by [Astro](https://astro.build/). The [source code](https://github.com/PrismLauncher/prismlauncher.org) is licensed under AGPL-3.

# [¶](https://wiki.indifferentbroccoli.com/Minecraft/BestModLaunchers\#the-best-mod-launchers-for-minecraft) The Best Mod Launchers for Minecraft

Mod launchers for Minecraft make it simple to download modpacks and install mods. Whether you're looking to overhaul the game with mods and modpacks or get simple client side mods for getting the edge in combat, these are the most popular and best launchers you can use.

### [¶](https://wiki.indifferentbroccoli.com/Minecraft/BestModLaunchers\#h-1-modrinth) 1\. [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/app)

Modrinth is one of the only open source Minecraft clients out there, boasting a ton of popular mods and modpacks. Modrinth also allows you the optional choice to make an account or not, but if you do you'll be able to share modpacks with others, and publish your own mods and modpacks. No matter what version of Minecraft you're going to play, Modrinth has options for you.

![Download the Modrinth App!](https://cdn-raw.modrinth.com/app-landing/app-screenshot.webp)

### [¶](https://wiki.indifferentbroccoli.com/Minecraft/BestModLaunchers\#h-2-curseforge) 2\. [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/download/app)

CurseForge is the most popular launcher, with the most modpacks and mods than any other launcher. CurseForge is known for being easy to use, and doesn't require an account for downloading and playing modpacks. CurseForge also has support for more games than just Minecraft, so if you're looking for an all-in-one launcher to handle all of your needs, CurseForge is a great option.

![Installing Minecraft Modpacks: CurseForge support](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/9201143650/original/atS0mUCYPXg1LBmKAuQBzUrTM1uP9hUz8Q.png?1702302356)

### [¶](https://wiki.indifferentbroccoli.com/Minecraft/BestModLaunchers\#h-3-prism-launcher) 3\. [Prism Launcher](https://prismlauncher.org/)

Prism Launcher combines both the benefits of Modrinth and CurseForge, and puts it into one simple launcher. While not as simple as Modrinth or CurseForge, you'll be able to easily customize what you want to see. You'll be able to install mods from almost any mod hosting site and manage all of your instances right form one launcher.

![Prism Launcher - Home](https://prismlauncher.org/img/built/1yCsNU_Ipb-1030.png)

### [¶](https://wiki.indifferentbroccoli.com/Minecraft/BestModLaunchers\#h-4-atlauncher) 4\. [ATLauncher](https://atlauncher.com/downloads)

ATLauncher is a very robust and customizable mod launcher that allows you to install a ton of different modpacks from Modrinth, CurseForge, FeedTheBesast, and Technic all in one launcher. If you're looking for another launcher that has a ton of customizability and flexibility, this is the one for you.

![ATLauncher – MC-Launcher](https://mc-launcher.com/wp/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/atl_4.jpeg)

### [¶](https://wiki.indifferentbroccoli.com/Minecraft/BestModLaunchers\#h-5-badlion) 5\. [Badlion](https://www.badlion.net/)

Badlion is a Minecraft Launcher that focuses primarily on performance and PvP. While it does allow you to install different mods off the bat, it's not as aimed at modpacks and mods as other launchers on this list. Another cool thing about Badlion is that they have a paid version that allows you to obtain access to emotes, capes and more cosmetics to other Badlion launcher users.

![Badlion 4.0 Beta Is Now Available! - Mod UI Revamp, FPS Improvements,  Crosshair Drawing, M1/M2/M3 Support & Much More! | Badlion](https://i.imgur.com/BhJLR3p.png)

### [¶](https://wiki.indifferentbroccoli.com/Minecraft/BestModLaunchers\#h-6-gdlauncher) 6\. [GDLauncher](https://gdlauncher.com/)

![GDLauncher - Your All-In-One Modded Minecraft Launcher](https://cdn.gdl.gg/assets/website-home-app-screenshot.jpg)

One of the most feature rich Minecraft clients, expect to find any mod you could ever imagine on this launcher, as well as a ton of customizability for modpacks and mods. You'll also be able to set instances for different types of modpacks or mod collections you want to play. GDLauncher also boasts that it has the most advanced Java manager that lets you customize your java installation.

# CurseForge vs Modrinth vs Prism Launcher Comparison (2026)

Published on2026-04-15

Compare the three main Minecraft mod platforms and launchers. Which one should you use for downloading and managing mods?

Written by Jochem, Infrastructure Expert, 5-10 years experience in game server hosting, VPS infrastructure, and 24/7 streaming solutions. [Read author bio →](https://space-node.net/blog/about-space-node)

## CurseForge vs Modrinth vs Prism Launcher Comparison (2026)

![CurseForge vs Modrinth vs Prism Launcher](https://space-node.net/_next/image?url=%2Fminecraft-hero-bg.webp&w=3840&q=75)

Three platforms dominate the Minecraft modding scene: CurseForge, Modrinth, and Prism Launcher. Each takes a different approach to mod distribution and management.

## Platform Overview

| Feature | CurseForge | Modrinth | Prism Launcher |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Type | Mod platform + app | Mod platform + app | Launcher only |
| Mod library | Largest | Growing fast | Uses CF + Modrinth |
| Open source | No | Yes | Yes |
| Ad-supported | Yes | No | No |
| Speed | Moderate | Fast | Fast |
| API access | Restricted | Open | Uses both APIs |

## CurseForge

CurseForge is the oldest and largest mod platform. Most mods are published here first.

**Pros:**

- Largest mod library
- Most modpacks available
- Author revenue sharing program
- Overwolf app for mod management

**Cons:**

- Overwolf app is resource-heavy
- Ad-supported (ads in the app)
- Restricted API (third-party access limited)
- Slower download speeds on free tier

## Modrinth

Modrinth is the modern, open-source alternative. It has grown rapidly since 2022.

**Pros:**

- Fast, clean interface
- No ads
- Open-source platform
- Fast download speeds
- Better search and filtering
- Growing mod library

**Cons:**

- Smaller library than CurseForge (but growing)
- Some mods are CurseForge-exclusive
- Newer platform with less history

## Prism Launcher

Prism Launcher is not a mod platform. It is a Minecraft launcher that integrates with both CurseForge and Modrinth.

**Pros:**

- Access mods from both CurseForge and Modrinth
- Manage multiple Minecraft instances
- Open-source and community-driven
- No ads, lightweight
- Built-in mod updating
- Java management built in

**Cons:**

- Not a mod hosting platform (no uploading)
- Requires a Minecraft account
- Less polished than official launchers

## For Server Owners

When setting up a modded server, you download mods from CurseForge or Modrinth (or both). Use Prism Launcher on the client to manage the matching modpack.

**Workflow:**

1. Pick a modpack on CurseForge or Modrinth
2. Download server files from the modpack page
3. Players install the same modpack via Prism Launcher
4. Prism handles Java version, mod downloads, and instance creation

## Which to Choose

- **Use CurseForge** if the mod you need is only available there
- **Use Modrinth** as your default choice for speed and clean experience
- **Use Prism Launcher** as your client launcher to access both platforms

Most players now use Prism Launcher with Modrinth as the primary source, falling back to CurseForge for exclusive mods.
